'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 712
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>Near the open desert I reside, to get past me you must abide. Go forward if you dare, for when you pass me, you'll be sweating by your hair.
|notes = Talk to [[Shantay]] at the [[Shantay Pass]] south of [[Al Kharid]].
|map = {{Map|3304,3124|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Jarr]].
*[[Desert amulet 4]] teleport to the [[Kalphite Cave]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] to [[Al Kharid]].
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] and run east to the desert.
*[[Ring of dueling]] teleport to the [[Emir's Arena]] and run south.
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Fire Altar]] and run south.
